statement: Russia and Ukraine sign a ceasefire agreement (full or partial) by November 30, 2026.
The US and Iran announce an agreed framework under which Iran reopens the Strait of Hormuz to commercial shipping, by December 31, 2026.
The PLA announces a named large scale exercise around Taiwan by December 31, 2026.
US forces conduct strikes or ground operations against targets in Cuba by January 31, 2027.
Lula is inaugurated for a fourth term on January 1, 2027.
Further bomb threats against commercial flights in Europe are publicly reported between November 6 and November 19, 2026.
A congressional committee holds a hearing or issues a subpoena focused on the conduct of the Iran war by March 3, 2027.
